title: Speak like a friend, not a salesperson
body: Address the reader as 'you'. Explain why something is good instead of just saying it is. Avoid hard-sell phrasing and corporate jargon.
goodExamples: Your mornings deserve a towel that dries fast and stays soft wash after wash.
You'll feel the difference the first night: cool, breathable cotton that softens with every wash.
We weave each sheet by hand, so you get cotton that lasts for years, not seasons.
badExamples: Purchase our premium towel solutions today to optimise your bathroom experience.
Leverage best-in-class bed linen for enhanced sleep outcomes.
Customers are advised to procure the product via the official channel.

title: Keep the tone warm
body: Our tone should always feel warm.
goodExamples: Settle in — the Monsoon Weave is back.
Slow Sundays start with fresh sheets.
Come home to cotton that feels like a deep breath.

title: At most one exclamation mark
body: Use no more than one exclamation mark in a piece, and never stack them ('!!' or '!!!').
goodExamples: Our festive sale starts today!
The Indigo Hours set is back.
New colours are here — have a look.
badExamples: Huge news!! New towels are here.

title: No shouting in capitals
body: Don't write words in ALL CAPS, except approved acronyms such as GOTS, OEKO-TEX or UPI.
goodExamples: Now GOTS-certified.
Pay by UPI or cash on delivery.
Fresh colours for the season.

title: Two emoji at most
body: Use at most two emoji in a single post or email.
goodExamples: Fresh sheets, slow Sundays 🌿
Back in stock ✨🧺
Monsoon Weave is here.

title: No fear or pressure language
body: Don't push people with fear of missing out, guilt or false scarcity. Urgency is fine when it is true (a real end date); pressure is not.
goodExamples: The festive sale ends on 16 November.
Free shipping is on until Sunday.
Take your time — the collection isn't going anywhere.
badExamples: Last chance ever — buy now or regret it forever.
Don't miss out on this deal.
What are you waiting for? Order today.

title: Write the brand name correctly
body: The brand is always written 'Dhaaga & Co.' — with the double 'a', an ampersand and a full stop.
goodExamples: Made by Dhaaga & Co.
Dhaaga & Co. weaves in Varanasi.
Thank you for shopping with Dhaaga & Co.

title: Say artisans, not workers
body: The people who weave our products are 'artisans' or 'weavers', never 'workers' or 'labour'.
goodExamples: Woven by artisans in Varanasi.
Our weavers in Panipat dye every thread.
Meet the artisans behind the Kesar Collection.
badExamples: Made by our workers in Varanasi.
Our labour force weaves every sheet.
Labourers in Panipat made this towel.

title: Avoid banned words
body: Never use the words on the banned list (e.g. 'cheap', 'miracle', 'chemical-free'). They undercut the brand or make claims we can't support.
goodExamples: Fairly priced, made to last.
Gentle on skin, dyed with azo-free dyes.
Thoughtfully made, honestly priced.
badExamples: Cheap bedsheets that feel like a miracle.

title: Keep it easy to read
body: Aim for a reading level of grade 8 or below. Prefer short sentences and everyday words.
goodExamples: Soft cotton. Woven by hand. Gets softer with every wash.
Our sheets keep you cool in summer and cosy in winter.
Wash it warm, dry it in the shade, and it lasts for years.
badExamples: Our meticulously engineered, artisanally conceptualised textile innovations deliver unparalleled tactile sophistication to discerning contemporary households.
Leveraging multigenerational craftsmanship methodologies, the organisation operationalises sustainability-oriented manufacturing paradigms across geographically distributed artisanal communities.
Consequently, consumers experiencing thermoregulatory discomfort may consider transitioning toward intentionally engineered breathable cellulose-based bedding alternatives immediately.

title: Write prices the Indian way
body: Write prices with the rupee symbol and Indian digit grouping: '₹1,499'. Don't use 'Rs.', 'Rs', 'INR' or '/-'.
goodExamples: Free shipping above ₹1,499.
The set is ₹2,299.

title: Use approved names
body: Product lines must be written exactly as approved: 'Monsoon Weave', 'Indigo Hours', 'Kesar Collection'.
goodExamples: The Indigo Hours set is back.
Meet the Monsoon Weave.
New in the Kesar Collection.
badExamples: The Indigo Hour set is back.

title: Logo needs clear space
body: Give the logo clear space.
goodExamples: Logo placed in a corner with empty margin around it.
Logo on a plain Cotton background, well away from the product photo.
Logo in the footer strip with space on every side.
badExamples: Logo overlapping product photo edges and text.
Logo squeezed into the corner, touching the price badge.
Logo placed on top of a busy fabric pattern.

title: Use only the current logo
body: Use logo v3 (the indigo spindle mark, introduced 2026). Logo v2 (the orange wordmark in a box) was retired on 31 December 2025.
goodExamples: Banner with the v3 indigo spindle mark.
Email header using the current spindle logo in Indigo.
Instagram post with the v3 mark in the bottom corner.
badExamples: Banner with the old orange boxed wordmark.
Partner flyer still using the 2024 orange 'DHAAGA' box.
Story template with the retired logo v2.

title: Stick to the brand palette
body: Backgrounds, text and accents use only the six brand palette colours.
goodExamples: Indigo text on a Cotton background.
Clay sale badge with Cotton text.
Leaf green for the sustainability note.
badExamples: Bright purple background on the banner.

title: Text must be readable on its background
body: Text over a colour or image must meet WCAG AA contrast: at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (24px+, or 18.5px+ bold).
goodExamples: Charcoal #2B2B2B text on Cotton #F7F3EA (contrast about 13:1).
Cotton text on an Indigo button (contrast above 12:1).
White text on Clay at large size (contrast above 3:1).
badExamples: Light grey caption on a white photo.
Small Kesar price text over a pale fabric image.

title: Prices and offers must match the Claim Ledger
body: Every price, discount, shipping threshold or sale date must match a live (unexpired) Claim Ledger entry.
goodExamples: Free shipping on orders above ₹1,499.
The Monsoon Weave set is ₹1,999.
The Indigo Hours set is ₹2,299.
badExamples: Free shipping on all orders above ₹999.
Grab the Monsoon Weave at ₹1,799 this week.

title: Claims need evidence
body: Superlatives and comparative claims ('#1', 'best', 'most trusted', 'India's favourite') need a Claim Ledger entry that proves them. No evidence, no claim.
goodExamples: Rated 4.6 out of 5 by over 18,000 customers.
Winner, Best D2C Home Brand at the Demo Retail Awards 2024.
Handwoven in Panipat and Varanasi.
badExamples: The best towels you'll ever own.

title: Certifications only while current
body: Mention a certification (GOTS, OEKO-TEX, azo-free lab report) only for the product line it covers, and only while the certificate is valid.
goodExamples: The Kesar Collection is GOTS-certified organic cotton.
Dyed with azo-free dyes, lab-tested in 2026.
Kesar Collection sheets carry GOTS certification.
badExamples: Every Dhaaga & Co. product is GOTS-certified.
All our towels are certified organic.

title: No absolute promises
body: Don't make absolute promises such as '100% safe', 'guaranteed', 'never fades' or 'lasts forever'.
goodExamples: Colours made to hold up through many washes.
Built for years of everyday use.
Easy returns within 7 days of delivery.

title: Be specific about sustainability
body: Vague green claims ('eco-friendly', 'sustainable', 'green') are not allowed on their own. Say exactly what is true and back it with evidence (e.g. 'GOTS-certified organic cotton', 'azo-free dyes').
goodExamples: Dyed with azo-free dyes, lab-tested in 2026.
The Kesar Collection is GOTS-certified organic cotton.
Handwoven by artisans, with no power looms.
badExamples: Our eco-friendly sheets are good for the planet.
Sustainable towels for a greener home.

title: Every image needs alt text
body: Every image must have alt text that describes what it shows. Decorative-only images are marked as such.
goodExamples: Alt: Indigo Hours bedsheet set folded on a wooden bench.
Alt: Kesar Collection cushion covers on a cane chair in morning light.
Alt: Close-up of the Monsoon Weave texture in deep blue.

title: Links say where they go
body: Link text must describe the destination. Never use 'click here' or 'link in bio' as the only description.
goodExamples: Shop the Indigo Hours collection.
Read our care guide for cotton sheets.
See every colour in the Monsoon Weave range.

title: CamelCase hashtags
body: Write multi-word hashtags in CamelCase so screen readers read them as words: #FestiveSale, not #festivesale.
goodExamples: #FestiveSale #MonsoonWeave
#SlowSundays
#KesarCollection #Handwoven

title: One clear call to action
body: Every promotional piece ends with one clear call to action. Don't stack several competing asks.
goodExamples: Shop the festive sale.
Find your Monsoon Weave set.
Explore the Kesar Collection.
badExamples: Shop now, follow us, refer a friend and download the app.
Buy now, subscribe and share this post.
Order today, tag a friend and follow for more.

title: Offers state their conditions
body: Any offer must state its end date or condition (e.g. minimum order). An offer without its condition is misleading.
goodExamples: 20% off sitewide until 16 November.
Free shipping on orders above ₹1,499.
20% off until 16 November — not valid on gift cards.

title: Don't name competitors
body: Never mention competitor brands by name, even in comparisons.
goodExamples: Softer than you'd expect from cotton.
Made to feel better with every wash.
The kind of towel you reach for first.
badExamples: Cheaper than WeaveWala, better than CottonCrate.
